## Change summary

Describe the added or modified resources and why they belong in the chosen topic.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I checked for duplicates across the catalog.
- [ ] Links are canonical HTTPS URLs without referral/tracking parameters.
- [ ] The descriptions are my own, factual and concise.
- [ ] I have not asserted unverified licensing, price, security or production-readiness claims.
- [ ] I have not included secrets, copyrighted third-party text or images without permission.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_catalog.py` passes locally (or I explain why it cannot run).
- [ ] I agree to contribute my original editorial text under CC0 1.0.
